The '''Goliath Lifter''' was a model of hovering [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]]. It consisted of a central sphere with large, clawed arms, as well as smaller appendages for more precise work. These droids could be found in the hangar of [[Sise Fromm's stronghold]] on [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]].
